messages:
sasha: Quick async pulse on Dedicated capacity orchestration — Q2 milestones and outstanding deps. TL;DR: procurement reports ~240 H100 GPUs arriving mid-May; rack power & network firmware are the pacing items. Need owners for firmware staging, reservation mapping, canary schedule. Who can take what?

kevin: Procurement update: manifest shows 240 units, current ETA 2025-05-12 (still subject to freight). I'm happy to own the reservation mapping and customer slot draft. Will post a mapping sheet by EOD Wed.

liz: Network: two TOR firmware images are blocked by vendor certs and signed-image gating. Vendor rep said they'll reply Thu morning. I'll escalate if no reply by 11am PT.

aman: Runtime note — we need a kernel build target for the RTLS/kv-cache change; without it we can't validate multi-tenant prefix caching. @eng-infra can you produce a kernel with CONFIG_RTLS and perf counters enabled?

raul: eng-infra here. We can build, but need the exact kernel version and test matrix. Can you paste the minimal config?

aman: sure — minimal config below:
```
# kernel bits we need
CONFIG_RTLS=y
CONFIG_PERF_EVENTS=y
CONFIG_KV_CACHE_DEBUG=n
# test targets
TESTS=burnin,kv_smoke,latency_regression
```

deploy-bot: Staging burn-in job queued. Command to run when racks are racked and PXE'd:
```
./burnin.sh --fleet h100-240 --parallel 8 --duration 6h
```

liz: Also, network needs a maintenance window for TOR image rollouts. Propose Sun 02:00-06:00 UTC — low traffic. Any objections?

zoe: Product asks we hold 20 GPUs for the enterprise pilot (north star customers) for the first month after availability. Can engineering carve these out in the reservation mapping?

kevin: I'll reserve 20 in the draft sheet under "enterprise-pilot" and mark them as on-hold. Sheet link (internal): https://redwood.internal/sheets/dedicated-resv-2025 (will share perms)

raul: For rack readiness: ops needs final power chain docs and PDUs by May 5 to schedule cabinet installs. @sasha can you confirm stakeout with DC ops?

sasha: Confirmed — I've asked DC ops to hold a slot the week of May 5-9. They'll confirm by Tue.

sasha: Owners summary: procurement -> kevin (manifest & reservations), eng-infra -> raul (kernel + rack prep), network -> liz (TOR images & maintenance window), runtime -> aman (kv/kernel validation + tests), product -> zoe (pilot GPU hold). I'll centralize milestones into a checklist in the infra repo and link it here.

kevin: ack

liz: ack :thumbsup:

raul: ack

aman: ack

zoe: ack

sasha: Thanks — I'll post the checklist and a minimal timeline (procurement ETA, rack install week, staging burn-in, canary start) after I get the vendor cert update. Next optional sync Wed 10:00am PT if anything blocks before then.
